title: Weight loss / hypermetabolism in pheochromocytoma (energy metabolism literature, via search synthesis)
content: Catecholamine overproduction in pheochromocytoma affects basal metabolism, resulting in weight loss despite normal food intake. Resting energy expenditure (REE) measured in pheochromocytoma patients was 10.4% higher than the predicted value, which explains the metabolic basis for weight loss. The prevalence of weight loss as a specific presenting symptom is not explicitly quantified in the available literature.
